name: Monarch: The Tainted Kingdom
description:
About This Game


Your Journey as a Hunter has just begun!

Step into the boots of a novice Hunter on their first day on the field. 

What starts as a simple adventure transforms into an epic journey to free a tainted land.

As you explore diverse biomes, you must go on Hunts to capture the local wildlife, harness the power of the mysterious Archs, solve environmental puzzles hidden within the ruins of this once great land, and make your way through foes and perils to become a true Hunter.


Embrace the Hunt

A true Hunter lives by going on Hunts and returning alive, each time stronger than before...Or having learned a new lesson.

Going on Hunts allows you to unlock, uncover and upgrade your party by visiting different habitats that are home to a wide variety of creatures, so always be on the lookout for new companions, items or skills to add to your roster.

Pack your backpack to get ready for the next Hunt, and remember to plan carefully! What you take is what you get to use on this journey. 

Enhance Your Village and Beyond

While progressing through the story of Monarch, you can enhance various aspects of your village through sidequests, item gathering, or exploring the right areas.

Unlock new quests, new items to take on Hunts, new skills and upgrades for your Party and much more content by helping the Village grow!

There's plenty to do in the Continent - Exploring a biome-rich land with an enticing storyline, side quests and plenty of hidden objectives, conquering Temples, solving environmental puzzles, and much, much more. 

Master the Combat

Combat in Monarch isn't just about picking an attack—it’s also about WHEN it hits.

Pick 2 Monsters from your Party to engage against up to 3 enemies in Timeline-based fights that allow you to power through, wait for the right moment to strike, or even disrupt your enemies' timing to defeat dozens of different monsters that go from mildly threatening to seemingly unbreakable.


Customize Your Party

Explore and pick from a vast list of skills, mods, passives and other modifications to customize your Party to your liking, from taking advantage of synergies between your Monsters to prioritizing speed, defenses, resistance and many other choices that allow you to fine-tune your combat and make it feel truly YOURS.
short_desc: Monarch: TTK is an Action Monster Taming RPG where strategy dictates the flow of combat. Capture monsters, gather their loot to build custom skillsets, and master an engaging Timeline-based combat system. Uncover the secrets of the Archs and break through the corruption plaguing the Continent!
